item.title: Holocaust Denier Jailed in France
item.description: A French Holocaust denier has been sentenced to an eight-month jail term. The specific details of the case, including the individual's name and the court that issued the sentence, were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A jury convicted a Vermont man of attempted murder for shooting three Palestinian students. The incident occurred in Burlington, Vermont. The students were injured in the attack. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
